title: Q-CONTRACT DEATH FINDING + RETYPING: the walk spine's S3 leg (for-all Q : R) was unsatisfiable for ANY finite wire (a dead form); Qside re-typing lands across 8 files (P12Uniform, ZetaZeroSet, E1Clause, S4Asm, Z78P12, S1Uniform, S1LowT, RHEnd); full build green; ALSO s31z2 dps-15 LANDED at 5e8G (logzeta = +2.9370199551, peak 92.6 GB)
body: FINDING (the Q-contract death): the P1.2 walk spine as written took hs1 as 'exists Q, Q >= devOf - Mf' and hs3 as 'for ALL (Q : R), Q <= Bwire + Mr'.  Those quantifiers are independent - hs3 never references hs1's witness Q.  As written, hs3 demands that EVERY real number is <= Bwire + Mr, i.e. Bwire + Mr = +oo, impossible for any finite real-valued wire.  So hs3 is unsatisfiable for ANY finite wire, which means the entire chain (P12.p1_2, ZetaZeroSet.rhIfMarginZeta, E1Clause if_E1_and_walk / if_E1V3_and_walk, S4A.rh_from_structural_hypotheses / rh_from_regime_closures, Z78P12.rh_actual78, S1U.s1UniformAndWalk, RHEnd.rh_program78, S1LowT strip_squeeze / strip_squeeze_v2) built on top of it is a stack of TAUTOLOGIES whose S3 premise can never be met by any concrete zero set: the theorems are green and correct, but they carry an unsatisfiable hypothesis and therefore prove nothing about any actual q.  The docstring intent was always 'THE SAME Q' (S3 bounds the very scale S1 exhibits), i.e. a single concrete zero-side scale Qside shared by both legs:  S1 = Qside >= devOf - Mf  (the measured |zeta| fill under the A4.3 wire dominates the detector less the bridge tail)  and  S3 = Qside <= Bwire + Mr  (that same scale sits below the definition-side wire).  RETYPING (landed, full tree build green 17450, 0 errors, no new warnings): the Qside contract is now a first-class parameter (Qside : R x R -> R) threaded through all 8 walk-spine files, replacing the decoupled exists-Q / forall-Q pair with ONE named scale in both legs.  Each theorem gained the (Qside) parameter and its hs1/h3 were rewritten to bind Qside; the squeeze_gives_margin bodies drop the 'obtain <Q,...>' and now pass Qside directly into the 6-tuple margin.  S1LowT strip_squeeze (the low-t P1.2 form, Mf devOf Bwire Mr flo) and strip_squeeze_v2 (Mf Bwire Mr, dev := devStripMin) were re-typed identically.  RHEnd.rh_program78 the ENDPOINT now states its S1 witness as 'hs1: Qside >= devProg' and its S3 wire as 'hs3: THE SAME Qside <= BwireP + MrP'.  NOTHING else about the squeeze, the closure, the [Z78] weaving, the data clauses, or the gate values changed: the re-typing is structural (quantifier discipline), not mathematical.  The dead form is recorded in the P12Uniform card GOTCHA and the PATHWAY B1 'WALK SPINE CONTRACT' note, so no reader re-derives it.  The four named RESIDUAL legs of the endpoint are unchanged in NUMBER (hs1, hs3, hWin, hS2low) but hs1/hs3 are now honest: they are checkable statements about ONE concrete scale Qside, not a decoupled exists/forall.  NEXT formal move (PATHWAY sec5): concretize Qside as a NAMED DATA FACE (the measured |zeta| fill under A4.3 as a def + Float gate on the audited band), so hs1/hs3 become data-supported faces rather than bare parameters - the same treatment the row faces / L-faces / covers already received.  NO RH claim: the endpoint still names an open residual; the re-typing only removes a dead hypothesis so the named legs are the ONLY residue.  SECOND ITEM (data, s31z2 in flight): the 5e8G dps-15 zeta call LANDED - logzeta = +2.9370199551 at t = 1.5000523e19, 4191.5 s, peak 92.6 GB - confirming the LAST reachable height is genuinely in-frame on this 124 GB box (the model predicted 83-95 GB; dps-15 landed at 92.6, ~11% above the low end but UNDER the OOM line).  dps-20 is running now (fresh process), then 30, 40 (the census channel).  If dps-40 lands, the staggered row protocol (s32a streams + s32b f64 merge) locks the verified extreme boundary at 1.5e19 and adds the best-leverage far row on this hardware; if any step OOMs, 9e18 stands and the only remaining levers are a C zeta channel or more RAM.  No RH claim.
